newsitem.title: PERU: Peru posts 1.9 pct Jan-Sept cumulative GDP rise.
newsitem.headline: Peru posts 1.9 pct Jan-Sept cumulative GDP rise.

text.p: The Peruvian economy grew 1.9 percent in the first nine months of the year, compared to 8.9 percent in the same period of 1995, the National Institute of Statistics and Information (INEI) said Wednesday.
The INEI added that year-on-year gross domestic product (GDP) growth was 0.4 percent in September, compared with 3.9 percent year-on-year growth in the same month last year.
